up: List all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL3881481. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name). Join the molecule records to the document and ensure each molecule is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3881481'
